_metadata.description: Weaponized coupling attack scenarios for RedTeam integration

steps: Identify permissionless function pair sharing value-bearing variable
Call function A to initiate state change
Immediately call function B before consistency check
Find oracle/price dependency with stale data acceptance
Trigger price-dependent function before oracle updates
Identify external call with state dependency
Trigger parent function to make external call
Inject state change during callback execution
Parent function continues with corrupted state
Map cluster functions and shared variables

integrationHints.hint: Start with P0-Critical targets from rankedTargets array
Use attackSteps[].prerequisites to determine required initial state
Build PoC following attackSteps[] sequence exactly
For maximum impact, combine atomicity violation with reentrancy if guards missing
Follow profitExtraction guidance from couplingExploits for value extraction

sourceCoupling.mechanism: Multiple contracts appear to track related state
sourceCoupling.description: OracleWrapper and FeeCollector both have variables: [admin]
sourceCoupling.exploitationScenario: Desynchronization between contracts can lead to inconsistent state
sourceCoupling.recommendation: Implement explicit synchronization or single-source-of-truth pattern

step1.action: Manipulate state that target function depends on

step2.action: Trigger source function with now-stale assumption
step2.timing: T+ε (after state changed but before detected)

requiredConditions: State can be manipulated between check and use
